title: Who Attacks, and Why? Using LLMs to Identify Negative Campaigning in 18M Tweets across 19 Countries
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance of Large Language Models for the specific task of classifying political messaging (negative campaigning) and then applies this method to a cross-national study. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral frameworks; mentions of ethical concerns are limited to brief acknowledgments of general field-wide issues.
